primitives.name: Acceptance Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: Every numeric acceptance gate in the compose chain is stated in a source file (the arxiv-deep ledger's own "Acceptance / rejection gate" sections), not invented by the brief layer.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Acceptance = {∀gates ∈ ledger} g ∈ G, where G = {g₁, ..., gₙ}
primitives.assumptions: All gates originate from authoritative ledger documents; no synthetic or inferred values exist.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Any deviation from ledger-specified gates triggers audit alert.

layer2.mapping: GSI verifies gate compliance against ledger entries; GSE enforces these rules during model deployment.
layer2.telemetry: Verification status of each gate against arxiv-deep ledger entries.
